Here is a detailed description of the illustrative figure for "Stage 4: Structured Arbitration Protocol".

---

**Figure Description: Stage 4 — Structured Arbitration Protocol**

**Overall Layout:**
The diagram follows a clear top-to-bottom flow, structured into four distinct horizontal tiers, representing sequential stages of the arbitration process. The overall aspect ratio is 4:3 (1100 logical units wide by 825 logical units high). The background is pure white. All text uses a clean serif font (e.g., Georgia or Palatino). The design is flat, with no drop shadows, gradients, 3D effects, or decorative elements.

**Components and Groupings:**

**Tier 1: Input Data (Top Center)**
*   **Component:** A single, rounded rectangle box positioned at the top center of the canvas.
    *   **Dimensions:** Approximately 450 logical units wide by 60 logical units high.
    *   **Styling:** Filled with pure white. It has a 2px solid border in a medium grey color (matching Grey #B0BEC5 from the palette).
    *   **Labels:**
        *   Line 1: "1,598 pairs with 3-rater judgments" (10px serif font, dark charcoal grey text).
        *   Line 2: "All pairs proceed to arbitration (not just disagreements)" (9px serif italic font, muted slate blue-grey text matching #4B636E).

**Connections (Tier 1 to Tier 2):**
*   A single, downward-pointing vertical arrow connects the bottom center of the Tier 1 input box to the top center of the Tier 2 arbitration protocol box.
    *   **Styling:** The arrow is a solid 2px line in a deep navy blue color (matching Navy #205493).

**Tier 2: Arbitration Protocol (Upper Center)**
*   **Component:** A large, rounded rectangle box centered below Tier 1. This box represents the core arbitration mechanism.
    *   **Dimensions:** Approximately 500 logical units wide by 130 logical units high.
    *   **Styling:** The main body of the box is filled with pure white. It has a 2px solid border in a vibrant orange color (matching Orange #FF7043).
    *   **Header Bar:** A solid vibrant orange bar (matching Orange #FF7043) spans the top of the box, approximately 25 logical units high.
        *   **Label:** "Arbitration Protocol" (11px serif bold font, white text) is centered within this header bar.
    *   **Body Content (Two Columns):** The white body area below the header is conceptually divided into two columns of text.
        *   **Left Column (Blind Masking):**
            *   "Blind masking:" (9px serif bold font, dark charcoal grey text).
            *   "Raters shown as A, B, C" (9px serif font, dark charcoal grey text).
            *   "No vendor identity revealed" (9px serif font, dark charcoal grey text).
        *   **Right Column (Order Randomization):**
            *   "Order randomization:" (9px serif bold font, dark charcoal grey text).
            *   "50% fixed presentation order" (9px serif font, dark charcoal grey text).
            *   "50% randomized (position bias check)" (9px serif font, dark charcoal grey text).
    *   **Annotation (Below Body):** Centered below the two columns, within the white body of the box:
        *   "Each arbitrator sees: all 3 rater judgments + reasoning + original question pair" (8px serif italic font, muted slate blue-grey text matching #4B636E).

**Connections (Tier 2 to Tier 3):**
*   A single, downward-pointing vertical arrow originates from the bottom center of the Tier 2 box. This arrow then splits into three parallel, equally spaced downward-pointing vertical arrows.
    *   **Styling:** All three arrows are solid 2px lines in a deep navy blue color (matching Navy #205493). Each points to the top center of one of the three Arbitrator boxes in Tier 3.

**Tier 3: Three Independent Arbitrators (Mid-Center, Grouped Horizontally)**
*   This tier consists of three identical, horizontally arranged rounded rectangle boxes, representing the independent arbitrators. They are separated by dashed vertical lines.
    *   **Component Template (Each Arbitrator Box):**
        *   **Dimensions:** Approximately 240 logical units wide by 120 logical units high.
        *   **Styling:** Filled with a soft mint green color (matching Light green #C8E6C9). Each has a 2px solid border in a forest green color (matching Green #2E7D32).
